Cristobal Division of said Court shall include all of the territory within the
lines of the ten mile zone, extending from the Balboa Division to the
Atlantic Ocean, and the area of Gatun Lake beyond the lines of the ten
mile zone up to the contour line of ioo feet above mean sea level and the
islands in said lake; and the peninsulas bordering on said lake which have
been taken by the United States for the purposes of the Panama Canal.

jurisdiction of the District Court arising in the Division of Balboa shall be

shall be tried in the town of Cristobal. The Governor of the Panama
Canal shall provide a suitable place in each of said towns for the holding of
the sessions of the District Court.

to be known as the sub-division of Balboa and the sub-division of Cristobal.
